definitions.explanation: a standard-sized umbrella with a full-length handle, as opposed to a folding umbrella

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長傘|なががさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きた。
examples.english: I brought a long umbrella today.

examples.japanese: {長傘|なががさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{持|も}ち{歩|ある}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧だ。
examples.english: A long umbrella is sturdy, but inconvenient to carry around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長傘|なががさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせた→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧。
examples.english: I left my long umbrella on the train, so I contacted the station's lost-and-found center.

notes:
Composed of {長|なが} (long) + ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧ (umbrella, voiced to がさ by rendaku). Refers to the traditional full-length umbrella in contrast to a ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧{傘|がさ} (folding umbrella). In everyday conversation, people often just say ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧ when they mean a long umbrella, since it was the standard type before folding umbrellas became widespread.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長傘|なががさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧: to open/use a long umbrella
- {長傘|なががさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to carry a long umbrella
- {長傘|なががさ}{立|た}て: umbrella stand (for long umbrellas)
- ⟦ビニール→ビニール：11140_biniiru⟧{傘|がさ}: vinyl umbrella (often long type)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧{傘|がさ}: folding umbrella — compact and portable, the main alternative
- ⟦{日傘|ひがさ}→日傘：04686_higasa⟧: parasol — used for sun protection rather than rain
- {相合傘|あいあいがさ}: sharing an umbrella (with someone) — a romantic image in Japanese culture
